description: This file defines a REST controller for handling order-related operations in a Java Spring application. It exposes endpoints for creating orders, retrieving an order by ID, and listing orders for a customer in a store.

classes.name: OrderController
classes.description: REST controller for managing orders, providing endpoints to create, retrieve, and list orders.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new order for a merchant store and customer, converting request DTO to domain objects and returning the created order response.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve an order by its UUID, returns 200 with the order or 404 if not found.

methods.name: listOrders
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all orders for a specific merchant store and customer, returning a list of order responses.
